लिखित

Creates a formatted string with `§` placeholders.

Translation status: हिन्दी reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the hi pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Creates a formatted string with § placeholders.

Syntax: \"<template>\"(<args>...)

Category#

format

Related#

  • पढ़ो
  • पंक्ति

Examples#

radix/corpus/scriptum/scriptum.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Creates a formatted string with § placeholders.

# =============================================================================
# लिखित — Creates a formatted string with `§` placeholders.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • String template interpolation — `"template § and §"(arg1, arg2)` replaces
#     `§` placeholders with positional arguments
#   • Templates can contain any expression as an argument, not just variables
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Confusing `लिखित` (template desugaring into function calls) with bare `§` interpolation outside of the template syntax.
#
# See also: पढ़ो, पंक्ति
# =============================================================================



# लिखित — string-template interpolation ("§" slots)
#
# "literal § more §"(arg1, arg2)   -- each § replaced by the corresponding arg
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   templateExpr :← stringLit '(' exprList ')'
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   Salve greeting, persona notice, and computed योग string.

main {
    const string नाम ← "Marcus"
    const int aetas ← 30

    # One slot
    const string salutatio ← "Salve, §!"(नाम)
    print salutatio

    # Multiple slots
    const string notitia ← "§ habet annos §"(नाम, aetas)
    print notitia

    # With an expression
    const string योग ← "10 + 20 ← §"(10 + 20)
    print योग
}

Expected output:

Salve, Marcus!
Marcus habet annos 30
10 + 20 ← 30
